# Vendored browser dependency

`xlsx.full.min.js` is SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, downloaded from the
official SheetJS CDN so Excel export remains available when the PWA is offline.

- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- License: Apache-2.0 (`SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt`)
